challenge: The rodent and macaque studies do not test the same EV source, preparation, reporter, dosing procedure, recipient physiology, or disease context, so neither a positive nor negative result can be transferred directly to SGL-001. A new experiment will only be decision-grade if it distinguishes intact EV-associated exposure from free reporter and quantifies nasal, pulmonary, systemic, CSF, and brain compartments.
limitations: The current evidence contains no candidate-specific SGL-001 material.
Reported localization methods may measure reporter or co-isolate distribution rather than intact functional EVs.
The evidence does not define a quantitative CNS exposure threshold linked to pharmacodynamic activity.
